page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature at the foot left and a catchword at the foot right. Small fragments at the left edge are from the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: queamus formam illam externam,quam Deus nobiscum gratiosè & cū fratribus noftris communicat? Jam plus satis aliena bona minuimus, mala amplificauimus, & noua insuper accumulauimus,vt deiiciamus quos ex mādato Dei opera noftra oportuit erigi. Quin potiùs agnoscimus testimonium Iehouæ apud hos & illos esse,in quos infesti ruimus ? Quin videmus Israelem esse, quemcunque Deus informat in sui illius testimonij communicatione? Quin cernimus eòdem alios contendere atq. nos facimus, ac de amplectendo Iehouæ testimonio retinendoque laborare ? Quin animaduertimus illos, abfque nobis esset qui importunè inter nos obstrepimus,ad celebrandū nomen Domini concurrere? Iinamus[?] potius illos, per Deū immortalem,in sanctis his studiis occupari,& bonum illorum studium Christiana prudentia duce omni studio induftriaque adiuuemus: neque committamus,vt facto noftro à bonis institutis auocentur,atque ad mala inardescant, prout in cōtentionibus humanis plurimùm euenit. Cur de circumstantiis rerum magnopere laboremus,& Ecclesias imprudentia grauissima inter se committamus ? Cur etiam propter actiones varias, si quas improbamus, & reipsa improbandæ sunt,perinde censores agamus in fratres noftros, ac si momento apud illos tota Ecclesia concidisset? page.notes: The first word of the page is read as "queamus" from the scan; the start is a fragment and stays so. "Iinamus" is doubtful, marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "fatis" is read as "satis" and "fi" as "si"; these readings are inferred from the long-s form and are uncertain. The "conse-" catchword shares its line with the signature "I 5" and is read as "conse-" with some doubt. No marginal notes are printed on this page. Small marks and fragments at the right and left edges are not transcribed.
